notes: Corrected: יָד of מִיָּדְךָ was marked unrepresented beside מִן holding a bare of. Rule 30 forbids marking the construct noun unrepresented beside a preposition holding the whole rendering, since no English word here writes יָד's own lexeme and its sense stands inside the one word exactly as the preposition's does; the two now share a unit headed on the construct noun, the suffix keeping thine own under rule 18.
should be able is fused across נַעְצֹר and כֹּחַ rather than splitting able onto the noun; splitting would leave neither morpheme a defensible share of the idiom.
so is marked added: the ASV writes three words (after this sort) for the two morphemes of כָּזֹאת, and so is the surplus.
